messages:
Jia: quick sync: Console needs a tiny audit surface for rule edits during rollouts. not full exports, just the breadcrumb list you can read without waiting for a job.
Soren: agreed. customers ask: who flipped the route, which canary, and link to rollback. needs to be instantish.
Lena: can we reuse the changefeed? worried about permissioning and volume if Console polls it directly.
Jia: idea: add /v1/audit/preview?entity=route:<id>&limit=20 that returns compact events. cache at CDN edge for 20s.
Soren: preview payload sketch: [{"actor":"email","verb":"update","target":"route:rb-1","rollout_id":"rl-42","snippet":"+rule:...","redacted":false}]. no heavy snapshots.
Lena: please no raw emails in preview. strip to actor_id and display_name. PII policy.
Jia: sure: actor_id, display_name (maybe pseudonymized), role, action_ts, rollout_stage, diff_snippet.
ops-bot: note: preview_hits metric will count against preview_quota.
Soren: how do we surface redactions? console should show "Event redacted (PII)" with a tooltip explaining why and a View Full Audit CTA.
Jia: View Full Audit triggers export job POST /v1/audit/export {entity, start_ts, end_ts} -> returns {job_id, presigned_url, expires_at}.
Lena: exports must include a signed manifest: {job_id, checksum, signer_id, signed_at}. legal requires download proofs.
Soren: sampling/cost: preview should be free in small amounts but have per-project burst quota. propose 200 previews/day per project, then rate-limit.
Jia: add param preview_mode=sample to return only 1 in N events for high-load tenants. also add header X-Preview-Quota-Remaining in response.
ops-bot: cost note: wide-enabling preview without sampling may double our read ops. recommend default sampling factor 5 for orgs > 500k events/day.
Lena: websocket tail? we could offer a WS /v1/audit/tail?ent=route:<id> for tenant-admins, but gate it behind entitlement "live_audit_tail". only Dedicated/private.
Soren: agreed. WS should use the same compact event shape and include proof_id for each event to link to rollout stage.
Jia: internal API debate: extend existing /exports with ?compact=true or create dedicated /audit/preview and /audit/export. leaning separate surfaces so quotas/entitlements are explicit.
Lena: separate endpoints simplifies client-side checks and reduces accidental heavy calls from Console JS.
Soren: design ask: show "Recent changes (preview)" card with small spinner and a link "Request full audit" that kicks off export job and shows progress.
Jia: curl examples for prototyping UI:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/preview?entity=route:rb-1&limit=15"
```
and export trigger:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"entity":"route:rb-1","start_ts":1700000000,"end_ts":1700003600}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
```
Response: {"job_id":"exp-9001","presigned_url":"https://s3...","expires_at":"2026-07-01T00:00:00Z","manifest_url":"https://s3.../exp-9001.manifest"}
ops-bot: reminder: export requests increment export_quota metric and may be billed.
Lena: compliance: every export must record who initiated the export and include an access_receipt signed by our signing key. we need to surface that in the console export history.
compliance-bot: alert: tenants with retention >365d require export approvals. Ticket created: COM-4472.
Soren: operational metric names: audit.preview.requests, audit.preview.cache_hits, audit.export.jobs_started, audit.export.bytes, audit.ws.tails_active. add sampling tags: tenant_sample_rate.
Jia: UX tip: when preview shows redacted=true, show CTA "Request full audit" which explains that full audit may contain PII and will be governed by tenant policy.
Lena: security: ensure preview omits sensitive fields and respects tenant-level redaction settings. also enforce RBAC: only viewers with audit.read can see preview; audit.export requires audit.export permission.
Soren: ok next steps: Jia to post proto schema + sample payloads in the RFC doc, Lena to draft permission matrix, I'll coordinate with infra for cost estimates and sampling defaults.
Jia: aiming to prototype the preview endpoint + tiny Console card by next Tue. will tag infra for load test.
ops-bot: automated: created issue PLT-9967 "preview + export surfaces for console" and linked this discussion.
